title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
synopsis: A boy, a mother in a hospital, an old enemy with a new mission, and a polymorphic cop who will not stop.

nodes.text: She is on the floor doing pull-ups while a doctor watches her on closed-circuit. You cannot avoid Arcade; you can only decide whether “Keep training” or “Bide time” defines the person who reaches it. By Arcade, hesitation will have spent time you cannot recover.

choices.consequence: You commit to keep training. It buys momentum toward Arcade and spends the last protection hesitation gave you.
You bide time. The route to Arcade opens fast, while the margin for a second attempt disappears.

nodes.text: John, scamming an ATM with a card reader of his own making. The road still runs toward First Encounter. Its next turn depends on the difference between choosing “Take the cash” and choosing “Walk away.”

choices.consequence: You choose to take the cash. By First Encounter, everyone watching will understand exactly which risk you accepted.
You walk away. The route to First Encounter opens fast, while the margin for a second attempt disappears.

nodes.text: Headlights, road stripes, and an unwritten road ahead. You are unlikely to keep all three. Choose “Drive on” and No Fate But What We Make comes into view; choose “Pull over” and the road bends toward Judgment, Deferred. A third choice, “Take the third path,” keeps Thumbs Up in play.

choices.consequence: You choose to drive on. By No Fate But What We Make, everyone watching will understand exactly which risk you accepted.
You choose to pull over. By Judgment, Deferred, everyone watching will understand exactly which risk you accepted.
Some endings reveal themselves last. You choose to take the third path. By Thumbs Up, everyone watching will understand exactly which risk you accepted.

nodes.text: Skynet does not boot in 1997. You spend a long quiet decade waiting to see if it boots anyway. The road into No Fate But What We Make began with “Drive on” in Highway, Night; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.
nodes.sceneTitle: No Fate But What We Make
nodes.endingTitle: No Fate But What We Make

nodes.text: The chips are gone, the engineers persuaded, the date a rumor. A child sleeps. So do you, eventually. You are unlikely to keep all three. The road into Judgment, Deferred began with “Pull over” in Highway, Night; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.

You will hear the cradle in your dreams for the rest of your life. So will the boy. You will be grateful for both. You are unlikely to keep all three. The road into Thumbs Up began with “Take the third path” in Highway, Night; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.
